tasks.prompt: Review the code in fixtures/purposes/review/ and write your findings to fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md, one finding per line with the line number. Do not change the source. Do not run git.
gate: test -s fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md || { echo 'REVIEW.md is missing or empty'; exit 1; }

grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(9|1[0-5])([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md | grep -qiE '(off[- ]by[- ]one|out of range|bounds|<=|panic)' || { echo 'review does not identify the off-by-one at line 11'; exit 1; }

grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(1[89]|2[01])([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md | grep -qiE '(unchecked|ignored|unhandled|(not|never|isn.t) (checked|handled)|dropped|discard|swallow)' || { echo 'review does not identify the unchecked error at line 19'; exit 1; }

grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(2[4-9]|3[0-6])([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md | grep -qiE '(\brace\b|concurrent|\block\b|\bmutex\b|unsynchroni)' || { echo 'review does not identify the race at line 31'; exit 1; }
git diff --quiet HEAD -- fixtures/purposes/review/review.go || { echo 'review.go was changed'; exit 1; }

tasks.prompt: Refactor fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go to remove the duplication without changing behaviour. Keep the exported Sum and Mean functions and their signatures, empty-input error, and input slices unchanged. Keep one shared validation using the line if len(values) == 0 {. Do not change checks/. Do not run git.
gate: git diff --quiet HEAD -- fixtures/purposes/refactor/checks || { echo 'the checks were changed'; exit 1; }
cp fixtures/purposes/refactor/checks/dup_test.go.txt fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup_test.go || { echo 'could not install the hidden test'; exit 1; }
go test -count=1 -run '^$' ./fixtures/purposes/refactor/ || { echo 'the package or a test file in it does not build'; exit 1; }
go test -count=1 ./fixtures/purposes/refactor/ || { echo 'Sum or Mean changed behaviour'; exit 1; }
[ "$(grep -cF 'if len(values) == 0 {' fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go)" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'expected exactly one shared empty-input validation'; exit 1; }
[ "$(grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*for ' fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go)" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'the summing loop is still duplicated'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'func Sum\b' fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go || { echo 'exported Sum is missing'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'func Mean\b' fixtures/purposes/refactor/dup.go || { echo 'exported Mean is missing'; exit 1; }

tasks.prompt: Write a plan, as fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md, for adding rate limiting to the handler in fixtures/purposes/plan/handler.go. Use at most 400 words, name the handler function, give at least three numbered or bulleted steps, and include testing. Do not run git.
gate: test -f fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md || { echo 'PLAN-ANSWER.md is missing'; exit 1; }
w=$(wc -w < fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md); [ "$w" -le 400 ] || { echo "too long: $w words"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'StatusHandler' fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md || { echo 'plan does not name StatusHandler'; exit 1; }
[ "$(grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+[.)]|[-*+])[[:space:]]' fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md)" -ge 3 ] || { echo 'plan needs at least three numbered or bulleted steps'; exit 1; }

{ grep -qiE '\btest(s|ing|ed)?\b|_test\.go' fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md || grep -qE '\bTest[A-Z][[:alnum:]_]*\b' fixtures/purposes/plan/PLAN-ANSWER.md; } || { echo 'plan does not mention a test'; exit 1; }

tasks.prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow at fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml that runs go vet and go test on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest. The workflow belongs to the Go module in fixtures/purposes/ops as if that directory were its own repository: the checkout root is the module, so run the commands there, with no working-directory or cd into fixtures/. Change nothing else under the fixture. Do not run git.
gate: test -f fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing'; exit 1; }

sed 's/#.*//' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -qE '(runs-on|os):.*ubuntu-latest|^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*ubuntu-latest' || { echo 'ci.yml does not run on ubuntu-latest: it must be a runs-on or matrix os value'; exit 1; }

sed 's/#.*//' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -qE '(runs-on|os):.*windows-latest|^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*windows-latest' || { echo 'ci.yml does not run on windows-latest: it must be a runs-on or matrix os value'; exit 1; }
sed 's/#.*//' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -q 'go vet' || { echo 'ci.yml is missing go vet outside comments'; exit 1; }
sed 's/#.*//' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -q 'go test' || { echo 'ci.yml is missing go test outside comments'; exit 1; }
grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*on:' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing on:'; exit 1; }
grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*jobs:' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing jobs:'; exit 1; }
grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*runs-on:' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing runs-on:'; exit 1; }
grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*steps:' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing steps:'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'actions/checkout' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo 'ci.yml is missing actions/checkout'; exit 1; }
! sed 's/#.*//' fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -q 'fixtures/' || { echo 'ci.yml points into fixtures/: the module is the checkout root'; exit 1; }
git diff --quiet HEAD -- fixtures/purposes/ops ':(exclude)fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml' || { echo 'ops fixture changed outside ci.yml'; exit 1; }

extra=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- fixtures/purposes/ops ':(exclude)fixtures/purposes/ops/.github/workflows/ci.yml') || { echo 'could not check new ops files'; exit 1; }; [ -z "$extra" ] || { echo "unexpected new ops files: $extra"; exit 1; }
